RECORD-TIME OBSERVABILITY_CORRECTION #2 (2026-09-14, 2026-09-14-06-40-20_irrlichd-0.6.3+9abf13d, git_head=9abf13d1): the daemon-side eviction bug that blocked this cell's first two attempts is FIXED. Commit 9abf13d1 ("fix(daemon): never let a proc-* pre-session evict a real session's PID claim", core/application/services/pid_manager.go) stops assignPIDLocked's same-PID stale-holder scan from deleting the real session in favor of a late-arriving proc-* presession claim. On this third live attempt the real session (01a09e37-4ef4-7232-86ac-22b1148e9208) is NEVER evicted: no transcript_removed fires for it at all (contrast the first two attempts, which both lost the real session's PID claim ~0.26-0.72s after birth). Instead the transient proc-31535 presession -- correctly the LOSING side this time -- gets its own transcript_removed at +5.4s and is retired normally via the existing sweepSupersededPreSessionsPeriodic safety net (process_exited for proc-31535 at +8.6s). The real session cleanly transitions ready(+5ms)->working(+5.14s, "force ready→working on first activity")->error(+0ms later, "session error → error", decided_by_rule=session_error, session_error_class=terminal_failed) and STAYS in error for the rest of its life (invariants confirmed: no state_transition to waiting or ready). turn_start and turn_failed are THEREFORE NO LONGER KNOWN_FAILING -- corrected below to assert the now-reliably-observed real arc.

teardown REMAINS KNOWN_FAILING, unrelated to 9abf13d1: process_exited for the real session_id still never fires on this third attempt either -- it is misattributed to the proc-31535 presession's pid instead (the SAME process-exit-misattribution bug, processlifecycle's watched map[int]string last-write-wins, that also hits session-end -- see that cell's notes). This is a SEPARATE, pre-existing daemon bug, not touched by 9abf13d1 and not newly discovered here -- no issue filed.

daemon_capability corrected bug -> full via this observability_correction: the scenario's own defining assertion (session reaches error and stays there) is now cleanly, deterministically observed through the recording pipeline -- matching the original assessment's verdict before the first-attempt record-phase correction. known_failing stays true at the cell level, now scoped to the teardown phase alone (process_exited misattribution), matching the established full+known_failing pattern used elsewhere in this matrix (e.g. pi/2-14_turn-aborted-by-error, claudecode/2-25_agent-process-crash-midturn).

session_birth and pid_bind are unaffected by any of this and pass cleanly across all three attempts: the real session's birth (ready) and its PID binding (pid_discovered) both land correctly on its own real session_id, independent of the later classification. cost/tokens are asserted false: no model_completed event exists before the failure lands (confirmed again on this attempt -- zero model/cost/token events for the real session).
